race.comment: THORSTEN (2) brings the most persuasive recent form after missing by a neck in a BM60 at Canberra, where he was slow away, covered ground and still finished strongly after having difficulty obtaining clear running. His Newcastle Mdn win prior showed he can convert that form, and Jess Taylor has already had one win and one placing from two rides on him. PURE MOTIVE (5) was sharp winning on debut at Muswellbrook, putting the race away quickly as favourite on soft ground. Should run the 1100m and the stable and jockey profile at this venue adds depth. Leading player again. PUTINACALL (6) has not missed a placing in four starts and was beaten a nose at Port Macquarie after being tightened, with a strong record around 1100m. Brings a strong SP profile and should be around the money. WON'THEARMECOMING (4) comes through a Class 2 second at this track when beaten half a length on soft ground. Has the right exposed standard to be a genuine danger again.
